facts.statement: Symptosuchus fossils date to the Late Cretaceous period.
Symptosuchus was found in Argentina during the Late Cretaceous.
facts.quote: It is known from the Late Cretaceous of Argentina.

facts.statement: Argentine paleontologist Florentino Ameghino named the genus Symptosuchus and its type species S. contortidens in 1899.
facts.quote: Argentine paleontologist Florentino Ameghino named the genus in 1899, along with the type species S. contortidens.

facts.statement: The genus Symptosuchus was formally described by Carlos Rusconi in 1934.
facts.quote: It was formally described by Carlos Rusconi in 1934.

facts.statement: Symptosuchus belongs to the parent group Goniopholididae.
Symptosuchus is classified in the family Goniopholididae.
Symptosuchus is classified as a reptile.

rejected.statement: Symptosuchus is an extinct genus of goniopholidid mesoeucrocodylian.
rejected.quote: Symptosuchus is an extinct genus of goniopholidid mesoeucrocodylian.
